scope: Only title V7 plus three official references; exploration/battle excluded.

environment.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 9.0-full_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

method.gain: No source normalization. Band shares, stereo fractions, normalized log-mel structure gain-independent. LUFS uses input fields only.
method.onset: Primary = mean stereo power mel flux. Mono legacy computed separately. delta=.05,.07,.10 robustness; tempo diagnostic only.
method.structure: 1s log-mel shape centered and L2 normalized; six seconds each side distance. 4s block timbre+chroma distances are not melody identity.
method.segments: 4 fixed-time excerpts plus 3 equal-24s positions using start=p*(duration-24). No beat/semantic alignment claimed.

structure.limitation: Timbre+chroma similarity does not identify melodic repetition; scores available only for V7.
